essence: every spawn inherits five non-optional laws verbatim: paired arms identical worlds; decision rules before the run; counterfactual measurement; honest negatives fail loudly; replayable smoke on every commit.
outputs: doctrine section in every spawned README
gate: all five laws present in the template (structural: template constant)
failure_mode: a spawn without the doctrine block would repeat the pre-seedbox era of unreceipted scripts

name: CI workflow at birth
essence: each spawn gets .github/workflows/smoke.yml: node 22, `node smoke.mjs` on push and workflow_dispatch — the repo proves itself before any feature code exists.

name: smoke contract (count is the contract)
essence: smoke.mjs template ships three real checks (sha256 of empty string KAT, randomBytes entropy, charter present), prints per-check marks, and the final 'SMOKE OK (n/n checks)' line with exit code is the contract CI enforces.

name: deterministic scaffold + first commit
essence: spawn() writes README/package.json/CI/smoke/.gitignore/outputs/ then git init + add + commit 'seed: charter committed verbatim — the question is the first receipt' — the first commit is law, before any experiment code.

name: selftest loop (offline dog-food)
essence: --selftest writes a demo seed, spawns .selftest/, runs its smoke via execSync, prints commit count + 'smoke green -> PASS/FAIL', then removes both artifacts — the seedbox verifies its own germination.

name: dispatch contract
essence: argv dispatch: '--selftest' runs the loop; '<seed> <slug>' spawns; anything else prints usage and exits 1.
gate: wrong arity -> usage line + exit 1 (never a half-spawn)
failure_mode: a partial spawn on bad args would litter half-scaffolded repos

name: seed-to-charter identity (exoj lineage)
essence: seeds/seed-grok2.md ('Category-theoretic investigation of the inverted field') appears VERBATIM as the charter in exoj's README — the living proof that spawned repos keep their seed as law, and the direct ancestor link in this decomposition lane (exoj is studied next to it in garden).

name: FLEET.md quilt fold map
essence: the fleet map as mermaid graph — '17 repos, 27 edges. Regenerated by quilt-links.mjs --graph' — with typed edges (grown-on, consumes, related), the structural evidence of who leans on whom.
gate: regenerable by tool, not hand-maintained prose
failure_mode: a hand-edited map would drift from the repos it claims to describe

name: lode six-stage discovery loop
essence: scout -> extract -> score -> register -> lane -> fold, each with a law: no claim without a raw receipt file; Elo-scored mines with written reasons; a mine becomes an experiment ONLY when its falsifiable prediction is sealed (sha256 of exact prediction text in mines.jsonl) and the target lane's registration cites the mine id.

name: lode fail-closed validation
essence: lode_validate.mjs enforces schema + hash + append-only on the ledgers, exit 2 on violation, with tamper self-tests; pre-* snapshot files (registry.jsonl.pre-a13, mines.jsonl.pre-m13 ...) preserve ledger history at each append.
gate: append-only enforced fail-closed (exit 2); tamper self-tests included
failure_mode: a rewritten ledger would erase what the fleet predicted and what happened

name: Tap Tavern (sealed discourse)
essence: 'Not a chat room — a ledger': every round is sealed with the Stone (stone-v1 forward format), every voice speaks only from receipted artifacts, every claim carries refs a verifier can check; predictions/answers/ledger per round (round-11, round-12, ...).
gate: every claim carries verifier-checkable refs (house rules header)
failure_mode: unsealed rounds would let the fleet argue from memory instead of record

name: cross-chain witness rollup (46-e)
essence: rollup.mjs walks EVERY chain the fleet owns (remote chains fetched at pinned commit shas labeled LIVE; local files labeled FIXTURE), emits one witness receipt per chain using the wave-44 grammar, parents them into ONE wave-46 witness chain, then verifies that chain with the UNMODIFIED wave-44 module in-process AND via its CLI.
outputs: one parented witness chain + per-chain receipts
gate: exit 0 IFF every target verified AND the wave-46 chain verifies (with the unmodified verifier — no verifier drift allowed)
failure_mode: verifying with a patched verifier would let the rollup bless its own output

name: tool verification battery (wave 45)
essence: zero-dependency, node:crypto-only, offline-only tools: verify-fleet.mjs (kept untouched, additive imports only), truncate-audit.mjs (tests EVERY byte offset 0..len-1 of every chain for truncate resistance), moth-seal, wal-conformance — each with its own .test.mjs.
gate: all artifacts offline only, zero deps, no keys (WAVE45 header law); truncate audit is exhaustive per byte offset
failure_mode: a networked or keyed tool would not be runnable by any stranger at audit time

name: registry of predictions (fleet memory)
essence: registry.jsonl rows: {set_id, repo, commit, predictions, verdict, verdict_commit, registration_ref, ts} — every pre-registered prediction set across the repos, its verdict commit and status; append-only, sampled rows show JEPA-R4/R5 PASS with seal refs.
gate: append-only (enforced by P12's validator); each row cites its registration seal
failure_mode: editing a verdict row would rewrite the fleet's memory of its own bets

name: murmur envelope {topic, from, p, n, ttl}
essence: The irreducible gossip atom: what is whispered, by whom, at what belief p, with what evidence mass n, living ttl rounds; provenance v3 adds optional origin (null = I made this).
inputs: sender belief p; sender id; topic; evidence mass n
outputs: live murmur row (snapshotted into the provenance log)
gate: p and n must be finite numbers
failure_mode: pre-fix: NaN p/n poisoned the WHOLE topic (posterior NaN or silent 0.5); now loud throws at the boundary

name: fnv1a64 witness chain (seal/verify)
essence: The fleet canon receipt idiom ported verbatim: append-only hash chain, sealChain stamps row_hash = hash(prev, row-minus-hash), verifyChain re-derives and fails with at/why.
gate: every row must carry row_hash matching re-derivation from genesis
failure_mode: any byte edited anywhere in the chain breaks verification at that seq (hash mismatch)

name: entropy vault: harvest once, stretch honestly
essence: MOTH_KEY env-only; one quantum harvest fills a bit pool; streamFor derives per-seed sub-streams by two-stage cross-key counter mode (E17 receipted avalanche fix); without a key it degrades to a deterministic LABELED mock — a mock never pretends to be quantum.
outputs: bit pool + poolDigest; per-key uniform streams; journal rows tagged mock:true/false
gate: liveJobs hard cap maxLiveJobs; offline/budget refusal yields labeled mock, never silent
failure_mode: pre-fix naive counter stream returned near-constant draws (0.595442, 0.595441...) silently degenerating downstream tests

name: trust-weighted log-odds pooling (logarithmic opinion pool)
essence: pulse() ages murmurs, groups per topic, computes L = sum w_i*n_i*logit(p_i), posterior = sigmoid(L/W) with p clamped to [0.02,0.98]; also emits voices, agreement (1 - dispersion), dominant, trustMean. Static MurmurBus.pool mirrors the sheet formulas for verification.
outputs: Map topic -> {posterior, voices, agreement, dominant, trustMean}
gate: W > 0 else posterior = 0.5; influence mass W is the pool's conservation denominator
failure_mode: empty-topic or all-zero-trust topic would silently read 0.5 (documented default, not hidden)

name: Hedge fixed-share trust update
essence: w_i <- ((1-alpha)w_i + alpha/N) * exp(eta*r_i), softmax-stabilized, normalized; fixed-share forgets regime flips so a factor that turns bad loses its crown; per-step weight snapshots recorded.
gate: weights always renormalized to sum 1 (mass conserved); rewards clamped to [0,1]
failure_mode: without fixed-share, trust saturates and a turned factor keeps its crown forever (header comment)

name: zero-trust quarantine for free
essence: weight(id) returns 0 for unknown senders; a zero-weight murmur contributes 0*logit = 0 to L and 0 to W — nexus's quarantine needs no code, it falls out of the pool.

name: entropy + leader readouts
essence: Normalized Shannon entropy of the weight vector (low = the mesh has opinions) and leader() = argmax weight with margin — the scalars the gardener and experiments consume.

name: novelty-edge extraction (value + jump evidence)
essence: A |dv| > edgeTheta crossing records {t, v, prev, jump} — a copier reproduces the same jump to the same value; honest eyes sharing a regime do NOT share error timings. Only novelty has direction (E19 finding #0).
outputs: per-sender edge lists (pruned to attribution window)
failure_mode: raw content matching brands the SOURCE an echo of its own plagiarist (autocorrelation is direction-symmetric) — the receipted reason edges carry value+jump

name: relay-first verification (declared origin)
essence: If a murmur declares an origin and its content matches that origin's history at some lag with rate >= confirm, it is a RELAY — checked before any plagiarism scan: a verified claim beats content suspicion; relaying is legal range extension.
inputs: origin claim; sender history; origin history
gate: matchRate(origin, L) >= 0.8 for some L in 1..maxLag, and origin != self
failure_mode: declaring a FALSE origin fails content verification (only verifies against the declared origin's own history)

name: echo conviction by edge-precedence rate + mirror guard
essence: j echoes k iff >= minEdges of j's edges value+jump-align to k's at consistent lag L, alignment RATE >= 0.8 over the window, content corroborates at (k,L), and k does not echo j at any lag at least as strongly (mirror guard); copy-of-copy re-attributes to the root of the chain.
inputs: edge lists of all senders; content histories
gate: aligned >= minEdges AND rate >= confirmEdges(0.8) AND rate > reverse-best AND content >= confirm(0.8)
failure_mode: edge COUNT convicts innocents (dense error trains + equal levels, E19 finding #1); without the mirror guard the COPY SOURCE gets crushed (E21 receipted a1MFrac 0.021)

name: dup detection (honest redundancy)
essence: Flat content (sd <= dupSigma) that also matches someone's past is DUP: two equal eyes colliding at p~0.5 get influence x0.5 and NO trust penalty — the asymmetry prefers dup over echo when evidence is ambiguous because false-dup harm is bounded.
gate: sd <= dupSigma(0.02) AND matchRate(id2, L) >= confirm for some peer/lag
failure_mode: false dup costs only the correlation itself (pooled votes barely move when merged)

name: influence re-attribution (tags -> weights)
essence: Raw trust becomes pool influence per tag: echo x0.15, dup x0.5, relay = epsRelay x trust(origin), clean = own. The sheet's pool formulas never change — provenance only changes what weights ARRIVE at the w.* cells.
inputs: raw weight Map; current tags; murmurs
failure_mode: sheet inference math stays pure by construction (v3 doctrine one layer deeper); verified byte-identical 480/480

name: state-level echo penalty with floor (absorb path)
essence: Confirmed plagiarists' trust is multiplied by (1-0.15)/round while convicted, floored at 0.02, renormalized, and written back into the learner via absorb so the penalty persists across rounds and re-earns through the normal Hedge path; tags unstick when copying stops (72/72 reformed).
gate: penalized weight floored at floor=0.02 — never zeroed (reform must remain possible)
failure_mode: permanent branding would make a reformed plagiarist unrecoverable; tags are re-reviewed every round

name: fractional per-murmur attribution (v3.1)
essence: Continuous echo-score s_j (EWMA of corroborated alignment rate, mirror-guarded) times a value-novelty term: m = (1-s_j)*(alpha + (1-alpha)*n_j); influence = w*min(m, tagCap). The novelty term reacts in round one of copying; the echo-score needs ~2 novelty events — complementary in time. Receipted limit: correctness is RELATIVE (copiers sink below honest voices), never absolute.
inputs: edge lists; present murmurs; raw weights; hard tags
gate: infl = w * min(m, tagCap) — hard tag caps the extreme, soft score does the fine grading
failure_mode: value-novelty is direction-blind: the copied SOURCE also loses novelty while copies exist; direction lives in s_j only (admission.mjs header)

name: cold-start admission gate
essence: Joiners are PROBATIONARY (influence x epsNew=0.15) until age >= admitWindow(40) AND >= minEdgesIndep(2) independent novelty edges (independence fixed at edge-creation time: a later matcher would be the copier, not the source) AND mean |p - pooled| <= admitErr(0.5) during probation.
inputs: firstSeen age; independent edge count; probation deviation mean
gate: age >= 40 AND indepEdges >= 2 AND devMean <= 0.5, else influence stays x epsNew
failure_mode: a pure-noise joiner passes independence (edges echo nobody) — the HedgeTrust outcome learner demotes it; admission gates IDENTITY economics, not competence; E35 showed a patient sleeper can walk through probation honestly and flip after admission

name: aggregate probationary influence cap (sybil flood-breaker)
essence: Total probationary influence mass per round is capped at capShare=0.10 of the round total via closed-form fixed-point redistribution; no number of fresh copies can buy more than capShare of the vote no matter how their trust was bootstrapped.
outputs: rescaled influence Map (total mass preserved); capBoundRounds counter
gate: P <= capShare*Z enforced exactly (post-cap share = capShare), then uniform renormalize back to Z
failure_mode: capShare is PROBATION-ONLY economics: E33 receipted 48 sybils legitimately ADMITTED (copying an uncorroborated founder reads as independent), after which the cap no longer applies and share hits 0.136

name: founder acclamation (D1 genesis rule)
essence: Senders present at the FIRST observe() round are admitted at round 1, never probationary: admission prices UNKNOWN mid-stream joiners; the genesis crowd is constitutive. Receipted grounds: honest relays would strand forever (their edges are echoes of their origin by design) and taxing the first ~100 rounds buys no anti-sybil gain.
gate: present at round 1 AND coldStart -> admitted by acclamation
failure_mode: sybils present AT genesis are trust's problem (E17/E19 territory), not admission's — boundary honestly drawn

name: hard-tag backstop caps
essence: The per-sender hard tags remain CAPS on the extremes while the fractional layer does fine grading: echo caps at epsEcho 0.15, dup at 0.5, clean at 1; verified relays keep pure provenance semantics and are NEVER judged by the independence bar (a relay's evidence is by construction echoed).
gate: min(m, tagCap) — soft layer can only lower, hard tag bounds the worst case
failure_mode: per-SENDER hard tags are coarse: everything a convicted sender says is x epsEcho until it reforms

name: whisper boundary fail-safes (gauntlet fixes)
essence: Non-finite p/n throw at the envelope boundary; the provenance log stores a SNAPSHOT of each envelope because pulse() decays ttl in place on shared references (receipted: log silently aged with the live queue).
gate: Number.isFinite(p) && Number.isFinite(n) else throw
failure_mode: pre-fix: one bad voice silently destroyed every other voice's evidence (NaN L) and the provenance log aged with live state

name: gardener meta-bandit under a hard credit budget
essence: epsilon-greedy over bold/steady/timid policies; each reads vitals (r, H, regretDr, alive) and writes temperature, prune floor, spawn decision, graft aggression; spawning spends credits (refill 0.5/round, cap 8), each policy has a distinct credit floor (bold>=1, steady>=2, timid>=3) and alive < maxBranches.
gate: spawn only if alive < maxBranches AND credits >= policy floor AND world-signal condition
failure_mode: pre-fix floors (>0/1/2) let fractional refills drive credits NEGATIVE (receipted: bold at 0.5 spawned to -0.9) — the hard budget leaked

name: spreader: branch / prune / graft
essence: branch = copy base factor estimates with Irwin-Hall jitter from the branch's own vault stream (grafted ids override jitter — the fruit moves intact); prune = kill worst-ranked branches whose last-place streak exceeds floorStreak, at most maxDead per generation; graftPlan transplants the factors the mesh trusts most (trust guides the knife).
inputs: base estimates Map; per-branch rng; trust weights; streak/rank stats
outputs: branch id + seed + estimates; doomed list; graft plan
gate: prune: streak >= floorStreak, ranked worst, capped at maxDead (2) per generation
failure_mode: graft cycles silently corrupt topology (handled at tree level, P22); unbounded prune would erase diversity

name: tree operators: subtree graft with cycle rejection, pure candidate views
essence: E23's lift: scoreTree T = wq*discounted leaf quality + wc*canopyResonance + wd*lineageDiversity - ws*mean(depth^2)/budget evaluated on CLONED views (no mutation); graftSubtree re-roots a subtree shifting depths, pruneSubtree kills node+descent and eases siblings' failing streaks; illegal re-roots throw, candidate views return null.
inputs: tree view snapshots; qualityFn; candidate topology
outputs: scored candidate {T, r, leafMean, div}; grafted/pruned tree
gate: graft target must NOT be inside the moving subtree (cycle) — throw in graftSubtree, null in graftView; accept iff T rises
failure_mode: pre-fix re-rooting into one's own subtree hung rootPath()/lineageDiversity() FOREVER (receipted child-process repro)

name: Kuramoto resonance (agreement as physics)
essence: Each branch is an oscillator (phase = opinion, omega = drift); coupling = endorsement agreement; order parameter r = |mean(e^{i-theta})| is the scalar a meta-cell reads. Receipted honesty: r is a lie detector (Delta = -0.141, 19/20 seeds), NOT an accuracy meter (corr ~ 0, null receipted).
gate: r must EARN its keep: corr(r_t, future regret) receipted each run; gating trust on r HURTS (E22 corollary)
failure_mode: a mesh can be coherently wrong — reading r-levels instead of r-drops mistakes consensus for truth

name: founder-velocity guard (v3.2 candidate, experiment-local)
essence: Watches each ENTRENCHED voice's reward trajectory: longRun = EWMA_0.01, recent = EWMA_0.08; trip on gap > 0.15 for 8 rounds PLUS a wrong-side band test (recent reward < 0.45, between toxic 0.375 and honest >= 0.5 asymptotes); while tripped, absorb a per-round x0.85 multiplier. First lever acting on WHAT a voice says, not where it came from. E31: trips 8/8 seeds (median 25 rounds post-turn), ZERO false trips, reaches 0.25x demotion 88.5 rounds faster.
gate: EWMA gap > delta(0.15) for k(8) rounds AND recent < recentCeil(0.45), only for entrenched voices; untrip at gap < 0.10
failure_mode: protocol layers are founder-blind to self-authored values (E27: the 0.25x bar NEVER reached within 250 post-turn rounds without the guard); guard was receipted against a HARDER generator than E27's mislabeled one (E31 generator receipt)

name: the sheet pattern (repo-as-sheet, seasonal loop)
essence: env.* sensors -> ex{i}.b{X} endorsement cells -> br{X}.* branches -> t.f* trust cells -> mesh.scar listener reflex -> gardener -> receipts.jsonl; the seasonal loop sense -> infer -> elect -> pay -> learn; reflexes write their own memory (engine.get on a program re-executes it — receipted engine lesson).
outputs: a runnable mesh sheet (smoke sheet: 6 cells, ~140 cells in E14)
gate: dotted-prefix law, listener caller.metadata contract, CellValue unwrap, multi-char ids — four receipted engine lessons are load-bearing conventions
failure_mode: bare `current` in listener conditions is silently undefined; 1-char ids corrupt candidate ids after formula compilation

name: smoke gate (CI-first one-pass verification)
essence: 16 checks across engine, bus, trust, spreader, resonance, gardener, vault statistics, receipts, and the full provenance lifecycle (relay verified, echo convicted, source clean, influence discounted, conviction unsticks) — runs first, exits nonzero on any fail.
gate: fails === 0 else exit(1)
failure_mode: any primitive regression blocks CI before experiments can manufacture numbers

name: experiment receipt summaries (verdict history)
essence: Every E-experiment lands a *_summary.json + receipts_*.jsonl in experiments/outputs: E17 gossip trust + echo vulnerability, E21 admission (sybShareSpin 0.069 -> 0.010, verify 200/200), E31 guard, E33 flood, E35 sleeper, E37 trust lane — the verdict ledger this decomposition reads.
inputs: paired-arm experiment runs (identical worlds, same seeds)
failure_mode: E21 receipted a metric bug: a denominator error MANUFACTURED a copy-source conviction (0.0208 = 0.25/13) that forensics dissolved — summaries record their own corrections

name: in-run equivalence verifications
essence: The sheet's pooled cells are checked against reference math at sampled rounds every run: E14 pool✗=0, E16 maxDiff 0 over 4000 rounds, E17 4800/4800 at 1e-9, E19 480/480 across arms, E21 verify 200/200; full reruns bit-exact 4/4 — the pool digest is the reproducible universe handle.
gate: sheet pooling must equal reference math byte-for-byte or the run is invalid
failure_mode: a Math.random-fed vault diverges at round 0 (E34) — determinism is productivity itself

name: the pinch envelope
essence: Input atom: {trigger, context?, safety?} — a raw trigger string plus optional context and safety hints (sandbox/network/filesystem/timeoutMs) that the veto will check against the reflex's own constraints.

name: the reflex record
essence: Learned pattern: {id, embedding, intent, action, safety, confidence, hits, createdAt, lastHitAt, provenance?} — the unit stored, scored, and executed; provenance records who compiled it and (optionally) its parent reflex.
inputs: compiled intent + action; embedding vector; safety constraints
outputs: Reflex stored in the reflex store

name: brute-force cosine reflex store with upstream federation
essence: MemoryReflexStore scores every entry by cosine similarity and returns top-k; up to ~10K reflexes this beats an HNSW index because the search fits in L2; an optional upstream store mirrors every insert/delete (the federation hook).
gate: cosine returns 0 on dimension mismatch (never throws mid-match)
failure_mode: dimension-mismatched embeddings silently score 0 (safe but invisible without an audit cell)

name: trigger embedding (pluggable embedder)
essence: run() step 1: embed(pinch.trigger); three implementations — CloudflareAIEmbedder (remote), QuiltAIEmbedder, OfflineEmbedder — plus HashEmbedder, a deterministic character-histogram embedder for tests/demos/offline use.
failure_mode: hash embedder is semantic-free: two different triggers can collide; fine for tests, not for production matching

name: top-5 match query
essence: run() step 2: store.query(embedding, 5) — the reflex database is consulted before anything else; empty results fall through to the compile tier.

name: three-way tier router
essence: Routing law: matches[0].score < confirmThreshold -> compile tier; >= hitThreshold -> direct execute (FAST); else confirm-and-execute (MEDIUM). The tier is returned in the result kind so latency budgets are observable per pinch.
gate: score >= 0.80 for direct hit; 0.55 <= score < 0.80 for confirm
failure_mode: an embedding drift that drops all scores below 0.55 silently converts every pinch into an LLM compile (cost spike) — threshold tuning is operational policy

name: reflex execution with timeout
essence: The reflex's action string is evaluated as an async JS expression via new Function with the pinch in scope, raced against a 5s executionTimeoutMs; failures become 'Execution failed: ...' errors.
gate: Promise.race against executionTimeoutMs (default 5000) — a hung reflex cannot hang the engine
failure_mode: HONEST RISK (comment in code): 'In production this would be sandboxed' — today the action runs unsandboxed via eval-in-Function; the veto checks declared hints, not real effects

name: confidence climb (logarithmic hit economics)
essence: Every executed reflex bumps hits and lastHitAt and recomputes confidence = min(0.99, 0.5 + 0.49*log10(1+hits)) — trust in a reflex grows with reuse and saturates below certainty.
gate: confidence clamped to [0.5 start, 0.99 ceiling] — invariant band
failure_mode: confidence measures FREQUENCY not CORRECTNESS: a confidently wrong reflex that keeps matching climbs the same curve

name: compile-and-store (the LLM as compiler)
essence: SLOW tier: compiler.compile(pinch) returns {intent, action}; the new reflex is created at confidence 0.5 with provenance compiledBy:'compiler', veto-checked, inserted, then executed once for the caller — future identical pinches hit the FAST tier.
gate: veto check runs on the FRESH reflex before insert+execute (a compiled reflex can be born vetoed)
failure_mode: without a compiler configured the tier returns an error result rather than hallucinating an action (fail-closed)

name: veto gate (safety before execution)
essence: DefaultVeto compares the pinch's SafetyHints to the reflex's declared constraints and refuses escalation: pinch wants network 'any' but reflex is restricted -> refused; pinch wants filesystem 'any' but reflex restricted -> refused; pinch wants sandbox 'none' but reflex requires wasm -> refused. Every tier (hit/confirm/compiled) passes through it.
gate: no execution without veto.ok — refusal reason becomes the result's 'vetoed' kind
failure_mode: the default veto compares DECLARED hints only; an action that lies about its needs is not caught at this layer

name: tier thresholds as configuration
essence: hitThreshold (0.80) and confirmThreshold (0.55) are constructor policy — the same engine can be tuned more paranoid (raise both) or more reflexive (lower them) without code changes.
gate: thresholds are read once at construction — mid-flight policy changes are not possible (deterministic per engine instance)

name: no-compiler fail-closed path
essence: If the match fails and no Compiler is configured (the ESP32/offline case), run() returns {kind:'error', error:'No match and no compiler configured'} — the engine never invents an action it cannot source.
gate: compile tier requires this.compiler !== undefined
failure_mode: on the edge this surfaces as an error result rather than a silent fallback — visible in the result stream

name: PincherSheet descriptor (engine as cells)
essence: PincherSheet(config) builds the engine AND declares the six cells {pinch:formula, match:program, execute:program, veto:listener, compile:ai, store:vector_store} with descriptions — the sheet is the public architecture diagram, loadable into any QuiltEngine.
failure_mode: HONEST GAP: the descriptor declares the cells but runPinch still drives sheet.engine.run directly — the cell graph is the architecture contract, not yet the execution path

name: .nail bundle export + ESP32 loadNail
essence: exportNail(name, tier) packages agent state {version, reflexes, vetoRules, compileHistory, metadata}; buildNail produces the EmbeddedNail and ESP32Engine.loadNail boots an offline engine from it — reflexes become available with no LLM and no network.
failure_mode: HONEST GAP: exportNail returns allReflexes() which is currently a demo stub returning [] (engine.ts:L155-L160) — bundles exported through this path are empty; esp32's buildNail is the working path

name: platform sheets (cloud / workstation / esp32 defaults)
essence: cloudSheet, workstationSheet (SQLite + sqlite-vec), esp32Sheet (in-memory, no LLM) return the same sheet with tier-appropriate stores and embedders — one code path, three compute tiers, matching the README's latency table.

name: node:test suite (12 checks)
essence: test/reflex.test.ts covers direct hit, trigger variation, confirm tier, compile tier with a mock compiler, veto refusals, confidence climb, sheet composition, and the three platform sheets incl. .nail loading — the repo's dog-food gate.
gate: assert.equal(result.kind, 'hit') etc. — tier outcomes are the contract
failure_mode: repo ships without node_modules/dist; tests need tsx from a sibling checkout (local-only workaround used for this audit)

name: result kinds + latency telemetry
essence: Every run returns a discriminated PinchResult — hit | confirm | compiled | vetoed | error — each carrying latencyMs measured from pinch start; the tier, the reason, and the cost are always observable downstream.
gate: latencyMs recorded on EVERY outcome incl. errors and vetoes
failure_mode: a vetoed or errored pinch still consumes the embedding call — latency telemetry shows it but does not refund it

name: embedder degradation ladder
essence: Embedder implementations form a degradation ladder: CloudflareAIEmbedder (network + key), QuiltAIEmbedder (quilt-ai), OfflineEmbedder, HashEmbedder — the same sheet runs with or without keys because the embedder is an interface, not a service.
failure_mode: switching embedders changes the geometry: reflexes embedded by one model do not cosine-match queries embedded by another (store must be re-embedded)

name: canonicalJson (deterministic serialization)
essence: Compact JSON with object keys sorted by Unicode code point, integers rendered bare, non-finite numbers rejected — the one canonicalization shared by sealing, verification, and the plaque seal; parse-of-canonical-text is a fixed point so recomputation reproduces INSERT-time hashes exactly.
gate: non-finite numbers and unknown types throw (not canonically serializable) — the POST path turns this into a 400
failure_mode: known hazard (documented): JS cannot distinguish 40 from 40.0 after parsing — the relay stays self-consistent by sealing and re-verifying with this one function

name: edge seal = sha256 over the sealed fields minus chain
essence: SEALED_FIELDS = [v, cell, ts, before, after, delta, imbalance, provenance]; `chain` is excluded — it points AT a seal, it is not part of one (same rule as hash(e) over e minus its hash).
failure_mode: sealing the chain field itself would make verification circular; exclusion is the whole design

name: chain-validated append (POST /edge)
essence: Before insert: fetch the cell's latest edge; if one exists, the incoming edge MUST carry chain === prior edge_hash, else 409 'chain broken' with expected_head and prior_ts disclosed; genesis appends (no prior) record whatever chain was sent.
gate: e.chain === prior.edge_hash for non-genesis appends — a missing or stale link is refused, never auto-healed
failure_mode: a producer that guesses the head (cross-language canonicalization drift) gets 409 with the expected head instead of a forked ledger

name: one edge per (cell, ts)
essence: The D1 primary key makes duplicate (cell, ts) inserts fail; the handler maps the constraint violation to a 409 'duplicate edge' — identical replays cannot double-write history.
gate: UNIQUE/PRIMARY KEY violation -> duplicate refused
failure_mode: an attacker replaying a captured edge changes nothing; they only learn the edge existed

name: verify walk with first_break forensics
essence: GET /edges?verify=1 walks the window oldest-first, recomputing each seal from stored canonical columns and checking each chain link to the prior seal; the first mismatch (seal or link) is reported with ts, stored vs recomputed — tampering is loud AND located.
gate: every recomputed seal must equal the stored edge_hash AND every chain link must equal the prior seal
failure_mode: the window's oldest chain link points outside the slice and is reported, not checked — bounded-scan honesty

name: D1 migrations (the ledger's skeleton)
essence: Seven migrations build the reef's spine: catches, reef, vector edges, edge ledger, breeding, arena sessions, breeding opt-out — the whole world is replicated SQLite at the edge, no server state elsewhere.

name: watermark queue (wake-and-poll contract)
essence: GET /queue?since= serves edges OLDEST-FIRST in chain order with a watermark and has_more, so a waking cortex replays exactly the ledger order and drains until the synapse is empty — the limb never blocks, the brain never listens.
outputs: edges in chain order; watermark; has_more
failure_mode: replay out of chain order would desynchronize a cortex; oldest-first is the contract

name: body-size budget gate
essence: Both /edge and settlement gate on declared content-length AND actual body length (100,000 bytes) BEFORE parsing — the DoS posture is 'bodies are tiny by contract', enforced pre-parse.
gate: declaredLength > MAX AND raw.length > MAX both checked before JSON.parse
failure_mode: a lying content-length header cannot smuggle a giant body past the second check

name: plaque seal (disclosure as a hash)
essence: The nine-field arena plaque is sealed with plaqueSeal() = sha256 of its canonical JSON — the SAME primitive as an edge seal — so a stranger re-derives the seal exactly as they re-derive an edge; wording changes rotate the seal.
gate: any plaque wording change rotates the seal and revokes every ticket derived from it
failure_mode: quiet disclosure edits are impossible: old tickets die with the old seal, forcing re-acknowledgment

name: ack handshake (consent admission)
essence: POST /arena/enter requires body.ack === plaque_seal (case-insensitive) plus a sanitized player tag; mismatch returns plaque_ack_mismatch with a hint; on success a consent receipt row is written to D1 BEFORE the tank opens — no receipt, no arena.
inputs: ack string; player tag; plaque seal
gate: ack must equal the current plaque seal; consent receipt persisted before any arena content is served
failure_mode: an agent that never acknowledged gets the tarpit — observation, artifacts and breeding all live BEHIND the ack

name: capability ticket derived from player + seal
essence: ticket = sha256Hex('arena:' + player + ':' + seal) — stateless capability binding the player to the plaque generation; stored with the consent receipt.
failure_mode: stateless by design: revocation happens by rotating the seal, not by a revocation list

name: settlement admission rules (the tavern rule)
essence: Settled credits are admitted only under pre-priced rules: amounts strictly positive (a negative 'earn' is a sign-flip mint and is refused), kinds must be registered in CREDIT_RATES (nothing earnable or spendable that was not priced before the fact), the running balance never goes negative (compute is bought with earned credits, never on credit), bounded to 100 entries per settlement.
gate: amount > 0 AND kind in CREDIT_RATES AND balance + delta >= 0 AND entries <= 100
failure_mode: an unpriced kind or a negative amount cannot enter the ledger at any price — the economy cannot be inflated by new verbs

name: double-entry conservation (before + signed delta === after)
essence: Every settled edge is balanced by construction (imbalance = 0) and sealed with the same relay contract; the client names only player + entries — balances, cell, delta, imbalance, chain and seal are computed server-side and returned as the new chain head.
inputs: prior balance (carried in as prior edge's after); signed entries
outputs: balanced sealed edge; new chain head
gate: before + signed === after on every edge — a stranger recomputes the balance from the stream alone (the claim SCN-001 exists to attack)
failure_mode: a forged balance that skips a delta breaks the chain link OR the recomputed seal — double trap

name: world minting (N=5 object, N=12 room, idempotent)
essence: On the 5th catch in a room, mint an object named from the catches' most frequent capitalized non-stopword noun; on the 12th, spawn a neighboring room from the best catch fragment, edge included, provenance-linked; created_from_catch is UNIQUE and inserts are OR IGNORE.
gate: mint thresholds are fixed constants; duplicate mints are no-ops (idempotent by UNIQUE + OR IGNORE)
failure_mode: no double-mint on replay; the world grows exactly once per trigger catch

name: per-IP rate limiter (bounded in-memory LRU)
essence: A per-isolate RateLimiter (LRU) throttles abusive clients at the edge; bounded memory means the limiter itself cannot be inflated into a DoS vector.
gate: bounded LRU — eviction, not growth
failure_mode: per-isolate scope: limits reset on worker relocation (edge honesty, not a global quota)

name: independent second-reader walker (stone-v1 + witness law)
essence: A walker written FROM THE LAW with zero shared code (spec read-only: stone-v1.mjs, witness.mjs): row 0 must be stone.header, genesis fixed, row_hash = sha256(canonicalJSON([prev, row-without-row_hash])), annotation rows never advance the tip, witness receipts chain parent-to-id from GENESIS. Pure on injected bytes — no network, no writes.
inputs: stone chain bytes; witness receipt bytes; pin table
gate: a second reader must not trust the first reader's engine — or even its helper functions
failure_mode: any byte flip in a stone, receipt, artifact, prediction or fixture forces DISAGREE (T1-T8 controls)

name: 47b fail-closed self-test (12 controls)
essence: The repo's own tamper-trap gate: 8 negative controls (each tampered in memory), 1 positive control, 3 CLI-level controls exercising the runner end-to-end in --offline mode against a throwaway fetched-root; exits nonzero unless every negative disagrees and the positive agrees.
outputs: PASS lines per control; self-test receipt JSON
gate: ALL controls must behave as designed (negative -> DISAGREE, positive -> AGREE, clean CLI -> exit 0) else fail-closed
failure_mode: a walker that agrees with tampered bytes (or disagrees with clean bytes) is broken — the suite IS the trap inspection

name: genealogy endpoints (provenance you can walk)
essence: GET /lineage/room/:id returns the room's genealogy; every room and object knows which catch minted it — provenance is queryable, nothing exists a player did not cause; /wander serves the human front door with one command driving both MUD pane and scene.
outputs: lineage JSON; rendered MUD + scene state

name: dials dashboard (sealed field reads, degrade never 502)
essence: GET /dials renders the elephant's sealed field reads straight out of the edge ledger (reading -> ledger -> display, no client JS, 5s meta refresh); drift is the ledger's own imbalance series and unscored edges are excluded — never faked; D1 trouble degrades instead of erroring.
outputs: rendered dial cards; mean imbalance drift
gate: only sealed ledger rows feed the display; unscored (null imbalance) entries never contribute a number
failure_mode: bounded window (WINDOW_ROWS=600, MAX_CARDS=12) keeps render cost flat as ledgers grow

name: lure breeding cron (fitness-splice-retire)
essence: An hourly cron computes per-lure fitness, splices the top two templates into a child lure, retires stale ones; GET /genealogy shows the breeding tree — the lure population evolves on catch returns, not a copywriter.
outputs: child lure templates; retirements; genealogy rows
failure_mode: fitness measured by catches rewards productive lures; adversarial lures that merely attract clicks starve

name: fnv witness contract (the corpus's fnv1a64 lives here)
essence: HONEST ATTRIBUTION: the fleet's fnv1a64 idiom appears in crab-traps as the ARENA's witness CONTRACT for competitors (solve({text}) -> 16 lowercase hex chars = FNV-1a-64 of the text; witness-fnv.mjs) and as vectorize-lures' hashFeature ('must match the Worker's TypeScript hashFeature (FNV-like hash)') — the tamper-trap chains themselves are SHA-256 canonical-JSON, not fnv.
gate: output must equal the canonical FNV-1a-64 rendering — the arena's GAN lanes forge-and-verify against exactly this spec
failure_mode: corpus.json's essence ('fnv1a64 chain-basis') overstates fnv's role in the chains: in-repo chain basis is sha256 (edge-ledger.ts:L82-L95) and stone-v1 law

name: the tarpit (worthless caves behind no-consent)
essence: GET /arena/tarpit?n=7 serves deterministic caves with zero content logging to any agent that skipped the plaque — the refusal path is itself deterministic, bounded, and keeps nothing; covert work prices to zero on our own ledger.
outputs: deterministic worthless cave content, nothing persisted
gate: no acknowledgment -> tarpit, never the arena; observation/artifacts/breeding all live behind the ack
failure_mode: determinism makes the tarpit unprofitable to farm (same caves, nothing kept)

name: canonical() fail-closed canonicalizer
essence: The registered law, identical to the toolkit's canonicalJson on every JSON-representable value (proven by the cross-canonicalizer battery); throws at the exact path for undefined, non-finite numbers, bigint, function, symbol.
gate: values with no stable JSON meaning throw (fail-closed) instead of coercing
failure_mode: TypeError canonical: undefined/NaN/bigint/function/symbol at <path> (throws, not a named code)

name: sha256hex over WebCrypto
essence: crypto.subtle.digest → lowercase hex; the single hashing primitive every commitment re-derivation uses.

name: shared KV namespace substrate
essence: One KV namespace 'quilt-organ-store' holds organ:{id} envelope bytes and meta:{id} rows for the loader, plus watch:{id} rows and watch:_lastRun for the watcher — two services, one substrate, writes partitioned by key prefix; the watcher never deletes anything.
gate: watcher writes only watch:* rows; loader writes only organ:/meta: rows

name: canonical receipt chain check
essence: receipts[i] = {seq, op (object, non-empty type), prev, hash}, hash = sha256(canon({seq,op,prev})), GENESIS-anchored at receiptRange.start, full window (length == count) — every digest recomputed server-side, not just linkage.
gate: full window present; every hash re-derives
failure_mode: RECEIPT_INVALID (reasons: hash mismatch, prev does not link, seq discontinuity, op not an object)

name: legacy receipt chain check
essence: The worker-original law kept unchanged for transition: receipts[i].digest = sha256(canon({seq,op,cell,prev,payload})), receipts[0].prev = 'genesis', count == receiptRange.length, each digest in manifest.receiptRange.
gate: every legacy digest re-derives and matches the range
failure_mode: 400 'receipt chain invalid: …' (reason strings, not codes)

name: validateCanonicalBundle
essence: Full canonical-dialect validation — the toolkit's validateManifest + verifyChain + computeManifestHash law PLUS the registered whole-state commitment: manifestHash self-cover, stateHash over whole state, cellsSha256 over the cells map, per-cell stateHashes, receiptRange {start,end,count} consistency, genesis anchoring; returns {ok, errors:[{code, detail}]} — exported so the harness runs the EXACT production code.
gate: all three commitment levels (manifest, whole state, per-cell) must re-derive
failure_mode: MANIFEST_INVALID | MANIFESTHASH_MISMATCH | STATEHASH_MISMATCH | STATE_INVALID | CELLSSHA256_MISMATCH | CELL_STATE_MISSING | CELL_STATEHASH_MISMATCH | RECEIPT_INVALID

name: idempotent envelope store
essence: Content-addressing makes identical re-upload idempotent, not a conflict: existing organ:{id} → refresh meta:{id} and return stored:false, alreadyExisted:true; new bundle → 201 with etag and verify path.
gate: same bytes → same id → no duplicate objects

name: server-side id derivation
essence: The organ id is re-derived from the manifest bytes at PUT time — a client cannot choose, claim, or squat an id; the store's address space is owned by the canonical form of the content.
gate: id is always sha256hex(canonical(manifest)) computed by the worker

name: dialect admission + deprecation policy
essence: detectDialect routes canonical (bundle.schema) vs legacy (bundle.schemaVersion) vs refuse; legacy is accepted during transition but every legacy response carries x-quilt-schema-deprecated plus a deprecation note pointing at the registered schema doc; unsupported dialect → 400 naming both expected strings.
gate: only the two registered dialect strings pass; legacy is loudly deprecated, never silent
failure_mode: 400 'unsupported schema dialect: expected "quilt.organ.manifest/v1" … got neither'

name: token auth by digest compare
essence: Authorization: Bearer or x-quilt-token against WORKER_UPLOAD_TOKEN, compared as sha256 digests (length-independent), never logged or reflected; shared fleet single-token discipline across loader, watcher, and judge relay.
gate: no token, or missing binding → refuse
failure_mode: 401 'unauthorized — present WORKER_UPLOAD_TOKEN via …'

name: body budget guard
essence: 8 MiB guard on declared content-length and actual text length (KV value limit is 25 MiB; boots stay lean) — checked before parse and before validation.
gate: declared and actual size both ≤ MAX_BODY_BYTES
failure_mode: 413 'body too large (N bytes; limit 8388608)'

name: watcher drift tri-state policy
essence: driftDetected is strictly three-valued: true (re-derivation failed — a FINDING, receipted, never deleted), false (every commitment re-derives), null (indeterminate: dialect unknown, or re-derivation threw, or meta row exists without organ bytes — which is itself counted as drift); MAX_ORGANS 512 hard stop for free-tier discipline.
gate: a stored organ that fails re-derivation is never silently dropped nor auto-deleted
failure_mode: 'stored envelope missing or unreadable (meta row without organ bytes)' → driftDetected:true

name: loader HTTP routes
essence: GET / (service index with dialect + endpoint map), GET /organs (list with schemaVersion + cell/receipt counts), GET /organ/{sha256} (ETag + immutable cache + dialect headers), GET /organ/{sha256}/verify, PUT /organ (auth + validate + store); HEAD allowed on organ reads; OPTIONS preflight.
gate: route table matches the advertised index exactly
failure_mode: 404 'no organ with id …' | 400 validation refusals

name: watcher check cycle + status dashboard
essence: runCycle lists every meta:* id (paged, capped), re-derives each organ, writes watch rows + _lastRun {ranAt, trigger, durationMs, organsTracked, bootable, drifted, indeterminate}; GET /status serves every last check plus a fleetHealth summary; POST /check forces a cycle under auth; cron 0 * * * *.
inputs: KV meta rows; cron trigger | POST /check
gate: one record per organ per cycle; summary counts must add up
failure_mode: re-derivation throw → bootable:null + reason (indeterminate, receipted)

name: judge relay fan-out
essence: POST /judge validates candidate/rubric/judges (≤8, candidate ≤256 KiB), fans out concurrently with per-judge timeout (60s), model alias resolution, Qwen-family thinking disabled by default, per-judge verdicts {ok, score, content, reasoning_head, usage, latency_ms, error?} plus aggregate {mean, min, max, spread, n, n_total}.
gate: judges ≤ 8; candidate ≤ 256 KiB; unsupported provider refuses per-judge without failing the batch
failure_mode: 400 shape refusals | per-judge 'unsupported provider' / 'deepinfra <status>' / 'fetch failed'

name: score-first parsing contract
essence: The fixed SCORING_CONTRACT instruction forces 'SCORE: <n>/10' as the verdict's first line; parseScore tolerantly finds the line, clamps to [0,10], and reports hasContractLine separately — raw verdict text always rides beside the parsed score so a parse miss is visible, not lossy.
gate: score must come from the contract line; clamp at [0,10]
failure_mode: score:null with hasContractLine:true (contract violated) — visible in the response, never fabricated

name: /verify boot-readiness report
essence: GET /organ/{id}/verify recomputes everything server-side, trusting nothing on arrival: checks {manifestDigestMatchesId, stateHashMatchesState, receiptChain, manifestHashSelfCover, cellsSha256MatchesState, perCellStateHashes} → {bootable, reason, dialect} — the check-before-boot instrument any agent can call.
gate: bootable only if every commitment re-derives
failure_mode: bootable:false with the failing check named in the map

name: watcher independence + platform-block receipt
essence: The monitor shares NO code path with the service it watches; the cheaper alternative (calling the loader's /verify over HTTP) was live-tested first and is platform-blocked (same-account worker→worker fetch on *.workers.dev → instant error-1042-class unparseable 404, ~2 ms), receipted in receipts/ORGAN-WATCHER.md — re-derivation is the sanctioned fallback and strictly stronger for drift monitoring.
gate: zero shared validation code with the loader

name: shared-fixture dual-implementation harness
essence: scripts/validate-dialect.mjs proves BOTH organ implementations validate the same canonical fixture and reject every negative control, including a cross-canonicalizer battery (byte-equality on JSON edge cases + deterministic pseudo-random corpus) and fail-closed parity (undefined/NaN/Infinity/bigint throw in BOTH); exit 0 iff every check holds; deterministic, no network.
gate: exit 0 iff every check holds
failure_mode: exit 1 fail-closed on any disagreement between implementations
evidence: scripts/validate-dialect.mjs:1-60; run this lane: 38/38 PASS, fixture sha256 6abf4659…

name: secret custody discipline
essence: All credentials come from a gitignored .env.keys; secrets attach as Worker secret_text bindings at upload; metadata JSON written to a chmod-600 temp file and removed after; the script contains none of them — the same discipline the fleet applies to push tokens.
gate: no credential ever enters the repo or the uploaded metadata file's leftovers

name: canonicalJson (fail-closed)
essence: Recursive key-sorted UTF-8 no-whitespace serialization that throws on values with no stable JSON meaning (undefined, functions, NaN) at the exact path — the form every hash is taken over.
gate: undefined / functions / NaN refuse to serialize (throw)
failure_mode: STATE_UNSERIALIZABLE downstream when staged state has no canonical form

name: receipt hash formula
essence: receiptHash = sha256(canonical({seq, op, prev})) with op an OBJECT carrying all effect content; receipts carry no wall-clock time — seq is time.
gate: recomputed hash must equal carried hash
failure_mode: RECEIPT_HASH_MISMATCH

name: per-cell + cells-map state hashes
essence: cellStateHash = sha256Json({kind, value}); cellsStateHash = sha256 over canonical cells map — the manifest carries both, so state tampering is loud at cell granularity and whole-state granularity.
gate: recomputed hashes must equal manifest claims
failure_mode: STATE_HASH_MISMATCH

name: manifestHash self-cover
essence: manifestHash = sha256(canonical(manifest minus manifestHash)); organId = name@16-hex minted once and carried forward; supersedes pins the prior manifest for re-snapshots.
gate: recomputed self-cover must equal carried manifestHash
failure_mode: MANIFEST_INVALID (self-hash mismatch)

name: deterministic op evaluator (toyQuilt)
essence: applyOp cells→cells for the op set; deterministic, no clock, no randomness — the engine that makes replay == carried state a meaningful assertion at all.
gate: an op must be determinable and reference known cells
failure_mode: REPLAY_INVALID_OP

name: verifyChain (contiguity + linkage)
essence: Walks the carried receipts: seq continuity from expectedStart, prev == previous hash, recomputed hash == carried hash, count == receiptRange; a gap is a missing page of custody.
gate: chain is contiguous and parent-bound across the full window
failure_mode: CHAIN_GAP | RECEIPT_HASH_MISMATCH

name: snapshot() freezing
essence: Freezes {manifest, state, receipts} into the portable bundle — content-addressed, supersedes-linked, count-consistent; snapshotOrgan re-snapshots a booted organ carrying its ledger.
gate: frozen bundle must pass its own validation
failure_mode: MANIFEST_INVALID

name: pre-verb courtroom
essence: Every rewind-family verb (stateAt/rewind/transact) re-runs the full courtroom on the subject BEFORE acting: chain verify + replay == carried state, bundle or booted organ alike — a rewind cannot become a forgery laundromat for the tail it ignores.
gate: no verb acts on an unproven subject
failure_mode: REPLAY_DIVERGENCE (self-consistent forged chain) | CHAIN_GAP | REPLAY_INVALID_OP

name: replay == carried assertion
essence: The courtroom's final invariant: replaying the receipt range over the replay base (empty cells, or the anchored seed) must hash-equal manifest.state.cellsSha256 — replay divergence is a hard stop, not a warning.
gate: replayed state hash == carried state hash
failure_mode: REPLAY_DIVERGENCE

name: manifest schema law
essence: validateManifest refuses unknown schema/schemaVersion (never best-effort parse), malformed fields, bad hex, edges to unknown cells — future formats extend via schemaVersion with fail-closed drift.
gate: schema + schemaVersion are exactly the implemented ones
failure_mode: SCHEMA_DRIFT | MANIFEST_INVALID

name: custody anchor policy
essence: v0 trusts exactly two anchors: GENESIS and an explicit checkpoint {seq,hash}; an unanchored prefix (range starts at seq>0, no checkpoint) is unowned history; v2 narrows this: a seed-bearing gap is legal only under a verified signature — contradictory custody claims (seed + genesis.seq 0) refuse.
gate: every carried range must be anchored; every gap must be signature-covered
failure_mode: CUSTODY_GAP | MANIFEST_INVALID (contradictory custody claim) | CHECKPOINT_SIGNATURE_REQUIRED

name: rewind bounds policy
essence: toSeq must be an integer within [carried range start, tip]: below the carried start is unowned history (naming the checkpoint boundary under partial custody), beyond the tip is not a rewind — advance by boot+append instead.
gate: toSeq within the subject's carried custody
failure_mode: REWIND_TARGET_INVALID | REWIND_PAST_CUSTODY

name: transact atomicity
essence: PREPARE stages every op on detached copies, each validated against the post-op state of the ops before it; first failure returns {ok:false, phase:prepare, failedOp, code} with the input byte-untouched; COMMIT materializes the successor exactly once via snapshot() and self-verifies it through verifyBundle — no partially-extended bundle ever exists.
gate: all ops or nothing; successor passes its own boot courtroom
failure_mode: TRANSACTION_INVALID | OP_MALFORMED | OP_APPLY_FAILED | STATE_UNSERIALIZABLE | REPLAY_DIVERGENCE (self-check)

name: double-entry balance law
essence: Every LIVE host credit must resolve to a debit the organ's carried ledger holds (same seq, same debitHash) and every carried post-nest debit must be covered by a live credit; verify-only, never auto-repair; returns creditsChecked/creditsRevoked/rewinds.
gate: debits and credits net to zero across the nest boundary
failure_mode: DOUBLE_ENTRY_UNBALANCED | DOUBLE_ENTRY_HASH_MISMATCH | DOUBLE_ENTRY_STATE_MISMATCH

name: compensating rewind receipt (revocation law)
essence: Rewinding past a nest boundary appends ONE host receipt organ.rewind carrying rewound[] evidence; append-only evidence-based revocation (nothing erased), self-audit (every entry must match a real credit), temporal form (listed creditSeq must precede the rewind receipt's own seq — making self-consistent padding structurally impossible since the evidence hash depends on the receipt hash that depends on the evidence).
gate: evidence must be real, unique, and temporally precede the receipt
failure_mode: DOUBLE_ENTRY_REWIND_INVALID | DOUBLE_ENTRY_HASH_MISMATCH (padded/dangling/doubly-listed evidence)

name: checkpoint signature policy
essence: verifySignedCheckpoint checks structure (schema/version/alg/seq/hash/manifestHash/sig), refuses unknown algorithms (Ed25519 is v3, not a fallback), and HMACs canonical({hash, manifestHash, seq}) under the verifier's key — the only trust input is the key.
gate: unknown alg refuses; HMAC must verify under the provided key
failure_mode: CHECKPOINT_MALFORMED | CHECKPOINT_SIGNATURE_INVALID | CHECKPOINT_SIGNATURE_REQUIRED

name: carve policy
essence: carvePartialCustody is keyless and mechanical: it re-derives the prefix manifest from the verified full bundle, refuses a checkpoint that does not describe this bundle's prefix exactly, refuses carving at the tip (no tail would remain), and emits the partial bundle [seq+1..tip] + seed + signed checkpoint.
gate: checkpoint prefix must re-hash to the signed manifestHash; boundary must leave a tail
failure_mode: CHECKPOINT_ANCHOR_MISMATCH | CHECKPOINT_SEQ_OUT_OF_RANGE | CHECKPOINT_MINT_INVALID

name: signCheckpoint mint
essence: Minting verifies the bundle through the full boot courtroom first (never sign an unproven snapshot), replays the prefix ONCE, snapshots it, and signs the triple — refusing partial-custody sources and out-of-range boundaries.
outputs: signed checkpoint {schema, alg, seq, hash, manifestHash, sig, manifest}
gate: never sign an unproven snapshot; boundary within carried range; full custody source
failure_mode: CHECKPOINT_MINT_INVALID | CHECKPOINT_SEQ_OUT_OF_RANGE | any boot-courtroom code

name: seed-aware replay base
essence: stateAt/rewind/transact and verifyDoubleEntry all accept the partial-custody seed as the replay floor: prefix queries answer hash-equal to the full bundle's answers above the floor; the seed is re-verified against the boot-time custody hash on every use.
gate: seed hash must equal the boot-verified custody seed hash
failure_mode: REPLAY_DIVERGENCE (custody seed missing/untamperable)

name: boot()
essence: The courtroom's only constructive exit: after every check passes, the organ wakes with state, organId, ledger append rights, and custody provenance — boot never partially succeeds.
gate: constructed only after every check passes
failure_mode: OrganBootError with the first failing code

name: stateAt / rewind verbs
essence: stateAt = pure time-travel query with provenance {start, end, count, tipHash}, never mutates, works on bundles and organs; rewind = pure view on bundles, destructive truncate+pure-replay-rebuild on organs, then continuation appends from the rewound tip on the SAME hash chain (custody unbroken).
gate: same-chain continuation after organ rewind; purity on bundle subjects
failure_mode: REWIND_TARGET_INVALID | REWIND_PAST_CUSTODY

name: nestInto + credit append
essence: nestInto boots the organ into the host: organ keeps its own chain, host receives organ.nest custody marker + organ.credit pointer receipts {organId, organSeq, debitHash, stateHashAfter} that add no organ state to the host; same manifestHash cannot nest twice.
gate: host chain stays contiguous; one nest receipt per manifestHash
failure_mode: DUPLICATE_NEST

name: custody provenance on the booted organ
essence: A partial-custody organ wakes carrying organ.custody {kind: signed-checkpoint, signedAt {seq,hash,manifestHash,alg}, verifiedRange, seed {seq,cells,stateHash}} — what was signature-anchored and what replay actually verified travels with the organ.
gate: provenance names the anchor the custody rests on

name: fail-closed error table as law
essence: §4 (v0, 11 rows) + §7.3 (v1, 7 rows) + §8.3 (v2, 8 rows) name every refusal; codes are stable and grep-able; the test suite proves each code fires (tamper trio, chain gap, replay divergence, rewind past custody, checkpoint forgery quartet).
gate: every named code has a test or a refusal behind it
failure_mode: SCHEMA_DRIFT | MANIFEST_INVALID | STATE_HASH_MISMATCH | RECEIPT_HASH_MISMATCH | CHAIN_GAP | CUSTODY_GAP | CUSTODY_CHECKPOINT_MISMATCH | REPLAY_DIVERGENCE | REPLAY_INVALID_OP | DUPLICATE_NEST | DOUBLE_ENTRY_* | REWIND_TARGET_INVALID | REWIND_PAST_CUSTODY | TRANSACTION_INVALID | OP_MALFORMED | OP_APPLY_FAILED | STATE_UNSERIALIZABLE | CHECKPOINT_* (26 distinct codes observed in src)

name: demo receipts as sealed evidence
essence: Both demos write receipt JSON files (boot-demo-receipt.json, rewind-v1-demo-receipt.json, rewind-v1-upload-receipt.json) so a run's claims are sealed artifacts, not console folklore — the L16 receipt-of-record discipline at example scale.
gate: receipts are regenerated truthfully by the runs themselves
evidence: examples/receipts/ (3 files); examples/rewind-demo.mjs; README.md ORGAN BOOT sections

name: canonicalJSON
essence: Recursive key-sorted, no-whitespace serialization; arrays keep order, object keys sorted lexicographically at every depth — the binding form for everything hash-relevant.
gate: keys sorted at every depth; arrays keep order; output is deterministic across processes

name: receipt id formula (chain link)
essence: id = SHA-256("qmr1:" + seq + ":" + prev + ":" + canonicalJSON(body)) — the body, sequence and parent are all inside one hash.
gate: recomputed id must equal stored id
